root_idea.summary: The root centers on driving away, expelling, and putting at a distance.
root_idea.development: The core verb develops into expressions for forceful removal or banishment; the verbal noun denotes expulsion or repelling, the passive participle denotes what has been driven away, and a derived noun denotes a means of driving away.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized verbal-noun citation form دُحُور.
Displayed under the normalized passive-participial citation form مَدْحُور.

senses.definition: Driving away, expulsion, or repelling; putting at a distance.
senses.usage_conditions: As a verbal noun, it names the action or result of removal. In the Quranic expression at 37:9, it may also be understood instrumentally as the repelling force or means—“that which drives away.” Comparative wording derived from the same root can intensify the violence or ignominy of this action without creating a separate sense.

senses.definition: Driven away, expelled, banished, or put at a distance.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle describing the resulting state of a referent cast away or excluded. In Quranic usage it can express banishment or rejection, including figurative exclusion from divine mercy; “rejected” and “abandoned” are contextual renderings of the same lexical state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or means of driving away or repelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for something that serves as an instrument or means of expulsion; it is identified lexically with the verbal noun دُحُور.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The core verbal action is covered by the verbal-noun expulsion sense.
Pointer-only entry directing the reader to the following material.
The driving-away meaning and its instrumental interpretation of the Quranic expression are covered under دُحُور.
Comparative intensification of the same repulsion, not an independent lexical branch.
The derived noun for a cause or means of driving away is represented separately.
The passive state of being driven away or banished is covered under مَدْحُور.

cautions: The instrumental interpretation associated with دُحُورًا in the Quranic expression at 37:9 is a construction-specific reading and should not be generalized to every occurrence of the verbal noun.
The contextual renderings “expelled,” “rejected,” and “abandoned” for مَدْحُورًا represent one banishment or exclusion sense rather than separate lexical meanings.
